query:
UPDATE games
         SET title = ?, sort_title = ?, summary = ?, play_status = ?, last_played_at = ?,
             last_played_copy_id = ?, local_max_players = ?, online_max_players = ?,
             local_coop = ?, online_coop = ?,
             updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
         WHERE id = ?
